problems.issue: Truncated meta description and HTML content in article excerpt ('Dentacare Philippines open')
problems.impact: Incomplete content damages brand professionalism and user trust during initial discovery.

problems.issue: Lack of structured data (Schema.org for Dentist/LocalBusiness) visible in the head section
problems.impact: Misses crucial local SEO signals needed to rank effectively in local map packs and search engine results across multiple branches (e.g., Batangas).

opportunities: Implement Local Business Schema markup for all 27+ branches to enhance local SEO visibility and Google Maps integration.
Add prominent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) details directly in the header or footer for immediate patient contact.
Optimize service card images and alt text for better accessibility and image search rankings.
audit.summary: Dentacare Philippines has a clean, modern interface with clear calls-to-action for bookings, but suffers from minor content truncation and lacks robust local SEO structured data to fully capitalize on its 27 branch locations.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Dentacare's 27 branches
outreach.body:
Hi there,

Managing 27 dental branches across the Philippines is no small feat, and I really like how clean and booking-friendly your site at dentacarephilippines.com.ph is.

While browsing, I noticed a couple of technical gaps holding things back. First, some article excerpts are cutting off abruptly, which can slightly affect first impressions. More importantly, the site is missing local SEO structured data, making it harder for Google to properly index all your branch locations in local search results.

I put together a quick live demo fixing these. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
